'GENUINE FORMULA DEFECT FOUND AND DOCUMENTED, NOT REPAIRED (per instruction to stop and report rather than silently fix): ADJUSTMENTS!K6:K255 (Flags formula) - =IF($A6="","",IF($D6="","REASON MISSING; ","")&IF(NOT(ISNUMBER($C6)),"VALUE NOT NUMERIC; ","")&IF(AND(ISNUMBER($C6),ABS($C6)>4,$A6<>"MARGIN OVERRIDE",$A6<>"TOTAL OVERRIDE"),"LARGE ADJ (>4); ","")). Expected: a non-numeric Value (col C) shows a clean "VALUE NOT NUMERIC; " flag. Actual (confirmed with a real formula-calculation engine, and verified this is standard Excel/Sheets AND() eager-argument-evaluation behavior, not a verification-tool artifact): ABS($C6) is evaluated as an AND() argument even when ISNUMBER($C6) is FALSE, producing a #VALUE! error that propagates through the & concatenation and replaces the ENTIRE flag string with a raw error, corrupting DATA QUALITY!B15\'s flag count for that row too. Proposed correction (not applied): replace the AND(...) term with IF(ISNUMBER($C6),AND(ABS($C6)>4,$A6<>"MARGIN OVERRIDE",$A6<>"TOTAL OVERRIDE"),FALSE) so ABS() is never evaluated on a non-numeric value. No v0.6.1 was created; this workbook\'s ADJUSTMENTS formulas are byte-identical to approved v0.5.2.'
